Class Ladder

java.lang.Object
forj.examples.tagless.Ladder
public final class Ladder extends Object
The capability ladder: each function asks for the least it needs, so it works with every effect that has at least that much. 
Functor → Applicative → Monad → ApplicativeError/MonadError → Bracket → Sync → Async → Concurrent
                                                                             ↘ Effect ↘ ConcurrentEffect
Callable is an Effect but not Concurrent: describe and retry work for it, withTimeout does not compile for it. IO is a ConcurrentEffect: all three work.
